scope: Rendered-page layout inspection on the same host, not external peer review or author submission approval

inspection.observations: No visible clipping or overlap. Tables, axes, captions, author footnotes, declarations and reference pages inspected. Dense tables checked at full-page resolution. Whitespace on final reference pages is intentional, not missing content.
inspection.limitations: Visual inspection cannot establish scientific validity or author approval; embedded font types and numeric-source checks have separate scope.
